preregistration.interval: paired log ratios Student t, Bonferroni 8; exploratory sample size, no optional extension
preregistration.acceptance: positive adjusted gain interval, gain lower bound above absolute same-condition A/A mean plus its 95% t half-width; no observed deadline misses; mixed-mask correctness and regression review. Inconclusive remains experimental.
preregistration.aa_guard_limit: Only two AA pairs per condition: df=1 interval is imprecise; a failed robustness guard is not proof of zero effect.

status: numerically validated experiment; no default promotion
